signalValue.note: Listed on FutureCast early target board

vaultScouting.evaluation: Turner is a tall Landstown QB. On the sophomore sit he drives the deep middle, throws with velocity rolling left, and finishes a designed keep. Processing beyond the first read is not on this clip.
vaultScouting.comparison: Turner comps to Jordan Love — 6-4 / 219 tall QB who can drive the deep ball and still move when the pocket breaks.
vaultScouting.projection: Turner projects as a Year 1 developmental QB, then he competes for the job in Year 2, with Year 3 starter upside if the base and second read catch the arm.
strengths: Turner steps up and drops the deep ball down the middle with the receiver in stride.
Turner flushes left and still drives the sideline ball with velocity on the run.
Turner gets the slant and screen out with a quick release before the rush arrives.
Turner keeps the designed run, breaks a tackle, and finishes in the end zone with long strides.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Turner fits a vertical-shot QB who can also run the designed keep — tall, live arm, still growing into the pocket.
